task.title: Sales totals by customer
task.statement: Using GROUP BY and SUM, return customer_id and total_sales for each customer.
expected_evidence: Group sale rows at customer granularity.

hidden_variables.name: repeated_customer
hidden_variables.purpose: Require grouping multiple sales per customer.

private.reference_sql: SELECT customer_id, SUM(amount) AS total_sales FROM sales GROUP BY customer_id
hints: Think about which entity should occupy one output row.
The grouping key identifies the customer; aggregate the amounts inside each group.
Start with SELECT customer_id and add the aggregate expression before grouping.
private.solution_explanation: GROUP BY creates one group per customer; SUM combines the amounts in each group.
